To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the combination of aromatase inhibitors and STI does not improve efficacy compared to the single agents in the first-line therapy of postmenopausal patients with advanced breast cancer.
the combination of endocrine therapy with signal transduction inhibitor is not beneficial in patients with hormone receptor-positive breast cancer.
the combination of aromatase inhibitors and STI does not seem to provide significant gains in clinical efficacy compared to the use of aromatase inhibitor alone.
